p:cNvPr.descr: PART 1: DNA strands are represented by simple, thin blue horizontal rectangles. At the top there are 2 stacked DNA strands, 3’ end on top of the 5’ end. There is a darker blue section of each strand at the middle. This is bracketed and labeled “region of target DNA to be amplified.” A down arrow has numbered phrases in gray text boxes on the right reading, “(1) Heat to separate strands. (2) Add synthetic DNA oligonucleotide primer; cool.” The image below shows the 2 DNA strands separated, with a gap between them. At the leftmost end of the dark blue region on the top strand, there is a small yellow rectangle, the primer, with a blue right arrow labeled 5’; an arrow like this is also present on the rightmost end of the dark blue region of the bottom strand. A down arrow below has text reading, “(3) Add thermostable Taq DNA polymerase to catalyze 5’ to 3’ DNA synthesis.” Below, the two separated strands have been cut, so that the top strand’s light blue region on the left is now gone. It has been replaced by the primer mentioned above. The same has happened on the right end of the bottom strand. The strands are now approximately 2/3 their original length. The 2 newly synthesized strands, identical to the initial ones, now sit at the top and bottom of the image, sandwiching the severed strands. Below is an arrow with text reading, “Repeat steps 1 and 2.” Below, the topmost new DNA strand now has a primer with a blue arrow pointing right just below the left end of its dark blue region; the same is true for the bottom new DNA strand, but the primer is on the right and pointing left. The original 2 center strands now have new primers as well, on the unprimed ends. A down arrow has text on the right reading, “DNA synthesis (step 3) is catalyzed by the thermostable DNA polymerase (still present).” Below, there are a total of 8 strands, either whole or segmented. The top strand is whole with no primer. The 2nd strand down has its amplified region (dark blue) primed on the left, with the light blue region still on the right. The 3rd strand down has only the amplified region with a primer on the right. The 4th strand down has its amplified region (dark blue) with the orange primer on the left, with the light blue region still on the right. The 5th strand down has its amplified region primed on the right, with the light blue region on the left. The 6th strand down is only the amplified region with the orange primer on the left. The 7th strand down has its amplified region primed on the right, with the light blue region on the left. The 8th strand down is whole and unprimed, dark blue amplified region flanked by light blue regions. Below is an arrow with text reading, “repeat steps 1 through 3.” Below, the 8 strands have changed again. The 1st strand is still intact. The 2nd strand down is the amplified region, primed on the left, with the light blue region on the right. The 3rd strand down is the amplified region primed on the right; the 4th is the amplified region, primed on the left, with the light blue region on the right. 5th strand down has its amplified region primed on the right. 6th strand down is just the amplified region, primed on the left. 7th chain is just amplified region primed on the right. The 8th chain is amplified region with primer on left and light blue region on right. Below, there is a large gap with another group of strands below it. The top strand is the amplified region primed on the right with the light blue region on the left. The 2nd strand down is just the amplified region primed on the left; 3rd strand is primed on the right; the 4th is primed on the left. These are all amplified regions only. The 5th down is the amplified region primed on the right with the light blue region on the left; the 6th strand down is just the amplified region primed on the left. The 7th strand is the amplified region primed on the right with the light blue region on the right; the 8th strand down is whole and intact. A down arrow points to a gray text box that reads, “After 20 cycles, the target sequence has been amplified about 106-fold.”
